$description: Copy of the synaptiq brand to adjust on the vk/adjustments branch. Synaptiq, from synaptiq.ai and the Synaptiq Design System (brand guide v1.1). Light is the brand as published: white ground, Soil text, Jasper links and calls to action, Arctic and Apricot Ink as supporting colours. Synaptiq defines no dark mode; the dark appearance is derived here (Soil grounds, Apricot Ink as the accent) and should be reviewed by the brand owner. Operator-approved 2026-10-06: the derived dark appearance, the darkened Grapefruit 'limited' state, and Google font stand-ins for the licensed faces. Atlas's look (2026-11-19): neutral greys and Iron text in light; Blackwood, Shadow and Iron with Sky in dark; Lava for errors; Sky primary fills, Arctic highlights and an Agave scale.
name: vk-synaptiq
title: vk-Synaptiq

ground.$description: A 4% grey page, so a container can sit on it in white or a 12% grey (Atlas, 2026-11-18; was white).

surface.$description: Cards sit on white and are set off by a hairline and a soft Soil shadow.

surface-sunken.$description: An 8% grey: fields, table headings and quiet panels, set off from the 4% grey page (was #F7F6F7).

ground-recessed.$description: Arctic 10: the cool tint the design system uses for sunken surfaces.

text-strong.$description: Iron #282828: headings and subheadings; 14.0:1 on the 4% grey (Atlas, 2026-11-18).

text-subtle.$description: Neutral grey: 5.7:1 on the 4% grey, 4.7:1 on a 12% grey (was #6F6A69).

structure.$description: Iron #282828: checks, selections and field labels (Atlas, 2026-11-18).

accent.$description: Not red: color.red-reserved keeps red for errors, warnings and delete, so links, selection, focus and kickers use Arctic, the brand's cool supporting colour (#A1B8CA), deepened to read as text (was Jasper #C4463F, which stays the critical status). At least 4.7:1 on every ground and surface.

on-accent.$description: White, as on the site's Jasper buttons.

status-negative.$description: Lava #DB1F26: destructive actions and errors; 4.96:1 on white, and white on it.

primary-fill.$description: Sky #B5DCEC: primary buttons and chosen segments, with Iron words (10.1:1).

highlight.$description: Arctic #A1B8CA: progress fills, highlight icons (not text: 2.0:1 on white).

sequential.$description: Agave #5C767A: an ordered scale (an assessment's levels) as tints of 20% to 100% over the surface.

destructive.$description: Lava #DB1F26 in both appearances, never lightened for dark (owner, 2026-11-25): destructive buttons' fill. White on it is 4.96:1.

selected.$description: Arctic darkened #527693, in both appearances: a checked box, a chosen radio and a switch that is on (Figma library, 2026-11-19). White on it is 4.9:1.

live.$description: Pine: the design system's on-track status.

limited.$description: Deepened 7% from #7E721A, so a pill's words keep 4.6:1 on the 8% grey.

purchasing.$description: Agave deepened 7% from #5C767A, so a pill's words keep 4.6:1 on the 8% grey.

closed.$description: Lava deepened 6% for status words and outlines (an invalid field, a closed pill): 4.6:1 on the 8% grey of pills and fields, 5.5:1 on white. Lava #DB1F26 itself is color.status-negative, the destructive fill.

logo-paint.$description: Soil: the butterfly mark painted flat.

logo-image.$description: The horizontal logo, synaptiq-logo-rgb_full-color-horizontal.svg from the Synaptiq Logo Pack 08/18/21, DIGITAL-RGB/HEX SVG, framed to its drawn bounds plus 4 units.

logo-aspect.$description: The framed logo's width over its height.

mark-image.$description: The butterfly logomark, synaptiq-logo-rgb_full-color-logomark.svg from the logo pack, framed square about its drawn bounds.

ground-recessed.$description: Neutral; the same step below the ground as before (was #1B1716).

text-strong.$description: White, as the design system sets text on dark (text-on-dark).

text-muted.$description: Neutral grey of the same brightness (was #C1BFBF); 8.0:1 on the surface.

text-subtle.$description: Neutral grey of the same brightness (was #ACAAA9); 6.3:1 on the surface.

structure.$description: Sky #B5DCEC in place of Apricot Ink: filled buttons and selections; 10.1:1 on Iron, and Iron on it.

accent.$description: Sky #B5DCEC in place of Apricot Ink: links, focus rings, outlines and accent text.

border.$description: Neutral; the same 1.38:1 against the surface as before (was #46403F).

status-negative.$description: Lava with 32% white: Lava itself is 2.97:1 on Iron, too dark for red text on dark; 4.6:1 on Iron.

primary-fill.$description: Sky #B5DCEC: primary buttons and chosen segments, with Iron words (10.1:1).

highlight.$description: Arctic #A1B8CA: progress fills, highlight icons, and page titles in dark (9.5:1 on Blackwood).

sequential.$description: Agave #5C767A: an ordered scale (an assessment's levels) as tints of 20% to 100% over the surface.

destructive.$description: Lava #DB1F26 in both appearances, never lightened for dark (owner, 2026-11-25): destructive buttons' fill. White on it is 4.96:1.

selected.$description: Arctic darkened #527693, in both appearances: a checked box, a chosen radio and a switch that is on (Figma library, 2026-11-19). White on it is 4.9:1.

limited.$description: Grapefruit, unmoved: it passes on dark.

logo-paint.$description: Apricot Ink: the mark on dark.

logo-image.$description: The horizontal logo, synaptiq-logo-rgb_apricot-white-horizontal.svg from the Synaptiq Logo Pack 08/18/21, DIGITAL-RGB/HEX SVG, framed to its drawn bounds plus 4 units.
